hooks.command: if [ -f package.json ]; then npm test --silent 2>&1 | tail -15; elif [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then uv run pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -15; fi
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) npx -y eslint --no-warn-ignored "$f" 2>&1 | tail -10 ;; *.py) uv run ruff check "$f" 2>&1 | tail -10 ;; esac
